For suspected vulnerabilities, follow the [security policy](https://github.com/theonetruedaniel/abrams-intelligence/security/policy) and use private reporting. Do not post secrets or security-sensitive exploit details in a public issue. This template does not authorize live dispatch or external effects.

## What happened?

Describe expected and actual behavior, and the affected command or file.

## Synthetic reproduction

Provide the smallest safe example, steps, repository revision, Python version and operating system. Omit credentials, personal records and private host details.

## Checks and output

Which checks did you run? Include only relevant redacted output, and distinguish failed, skipped and unrun checks.
